rationale: The material prompt requirement is Twitter/X launch-post schedule and engagement tracking. At # Postmortem Writer, the source is scoped to Writes blameless incident postmortems with a log-reconstructed timeline, multi-causal contributing factors, and owned, dated action items. Use when someone asks "write the postmortem for yesterday's outage", "run a blameless retro on this incident", "turn these incident notes into a postmortem doc",; that scope does not provide a plausible route to the required input/output boundary.
